title: THC Advanced Propagation and Tissue Culture
description: Advanced Propagation and Tissue Culture prepares experienced plant-production learners to evaluate aseptic workflow, culture establishment, contamination patterns, multiplication/regeneration tradeoffs, acclimatization performance and germplasm-fidelity evidence using traceable batch records and controlled comparisons.
intendedAudience: Advanced propagation technicians and controlled-environment plant-production staff
Staff supporting tissue-culture establishment, micropropagation, contamination control or germplasm QA
Learners progressing toward propagation lead, clean-stock or plant-biotechnology specialist pathways
prerequisites: Foundational propagation, sanitation and plant-development knowledge is recommended.
Learners should understand batch identity, contamination-control, acclimatization and basic experimental-comparison terminology.
Prior supervised experience with clean-work practices is recommended before practical assessment.
learningOutcomes: Evaluate aseptic workspace flow and identify cross-contamination risks using directional movement, staged materials and batch separation.
Interpret culture-establishment outcomes in the context of donor condition, explant type, genotype and medium rather than treating establishment as one universal protocol.
Use contamination timing and batch clustering to distinguish likely donor, workflow, operator or material-lot contributors and select a traceable corrective-action path.
Compare multiplication or regeneration treatments using multiple quality outcomes rather than shoot count alone.
Interpret genotype-by-treatment differences without generalizing one line's response to all germplasm.
Evaluate rooting and acclimatization as a connected transition using survival, new growth, humidity transition, substrate and genotype evidence.
Use passage history, regeneration route, morphology and retained-reference comparisons to support germplasm-fidelity QA.
Separate observed contamination, suspected source and confirmed cause in technical records.
Design a batch-level review that preserves operator, donor, explant, medium lot, transfer date and outcome traceability.
Produce a supervisor-ready propagation QA report with measured outcomes, uncertainty, next checks, corrective actions and escalation boundaries.
evidencePolicy: Course conclusions should use plant tissue-culture and controlled-environment propagation evidence appropriate to the mechanism being taught. Genotype-, explant-, medium- or study-specific results must not be presented as universal protocols. Contamination patterns, fidelity concerns and regeneration outcomes must preserve uncertainty until supported by appropriate evidence.
assessmentPolicy: Instruction uses batch records, contamination-cluster cases, genotype-by-treatment comparisons, acclimatization data and fidelity-QA scenarios. Module checks are formative. The final credential assessment remains fail-closed until adequate bank depth, human review, accessibility review, pilot evidence and standard-setting are complete. Practical performance requires a dedicated micropropagation QA case rather than the broader Technician II propagation/canopy practical, because the latter does not directly assess the course's tissue-culture competencies.

extensions.roleBoundary: The learner may evaluate records, identify likely process failures, perform approved clean-work and propagation procedures, and recommend verification or escalation. The course does not authorize unsafe biological handling, unsupported diagnosis, unapproved chemical/process changes, or independent laboratory claims beyond available evidence.
extensions.credentialStatement: Successful completion may contribute to the THC Advanced Propagation and Tissue Culture certificate when all written assessment, practical, review, identity, issuance and release requirements are active. The credential documents educational/workforce achievement and is not a government license or independent personnel certification.
productionActivationRequirements: Expand and validate final-assessment bank depth across all six objectives.
Add and validate the dedicated tissue-culture QA practical.
Record human SME and assessment review.
Run learner pilot and item-analysis review.
Calibrate practical assessors and document passing-threshold rationale.
Verify source freshness and learner rendering.
Verify credential identity, issuance and public-verification flow.
